plan: Drive: from Lower Post, about 69 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.96833, -127.5507, pull off on Hwy 97 (Alaska Hwy) (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 360 m NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 7 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-52, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2024-12-12, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BH-duck-walk-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-52: about 4,194 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.24 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.4 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).

plan: Drive: from Lower Post, about 68 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.98464, -127.56331, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 1.7 km NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 23 m, about 36 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip). Also: black bear (see evidence).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-52, Region 7B. Season: moose spike fork, tripalm or 10 point bulls Sept 1 to Oct 31 and more rows (synopsis page 62, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.

R7BH-moose-walk-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-52: about 947 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.05 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Beginner friendly
tags.why: Quieter spot only 1.7 km from the parking: fewer hunters, short walk back (Tip, estimate).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).
